audit.whatIsWrong: Vault is described as 'a knockback and nearsight' in three places. It is neither. Riot: 'Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing physical damage and SLOWING the target's Move Speed. Upon reaching the target, she leaps off the target, briefly INTERRUPTING it, and lands near her maximum Attack Range away.' The vision hinder belongs to Blinding Assault (Q), and the displacement moves HER, not you.
audit.why: Two different mistakes with real consequences. You are not knocked anywhere by Vault, so your positioning survives it — but you ARE interrupted, which matters because Snip Snip! is a six-snip cone. And the blind lives on an 11-second Q, which is the ability that actually turns off your Skip 'n Slash on-hit build for its duration. Aiming your caution at the wrong ability means you dodge the wrong thing.
audit.corrected: Vault described as a slow plus a brief interrupt that repositions her; the blind attributed to Blinding Assault (Q, 11s).

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart calls Levels 4-5 and Level 6 even and gives first item and 2+ items to Quinn, while whys[3] through whys[6] all say Gwen owns everything from the moment Hallowed Mist exists.
audit.why: Gwen wins this lane at 55.64%. Quinn owns levels 1-3 and nothing after.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Quinn / Quinn / Quinn / Gwen / Gwen / Gwen / Gwen in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Snip when Vault is down' with no number, and Heightened Senses is never mentioned at all.
audit.why: Vault is 12/11/10/9/8s and Blinding Assault 11s, but the striking number is Heightened Senses at 50/45/40/35/30s — fifty seconds at rank 1. Her attack speed and move speed advantage is not permanent, and a Quinn who has spent it is a much easier target.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to the whys, spike and cooldown breakdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page twice calls Behind Enemy Lines a 'global'.
audit.why: It is a channelled fast-travel that ends in Skystrike — she has to fly there, and it can be interrupted. Calling it global overstates how fast she can abandon a side lane and undersells your ability to punish the channel.
audit.corrected: Described as a fast-travel channel rather than a global.

edits.before: Quinn out-ranges you early: Harrier-marked autos and her vault poke chip you while she kites on passive move speed, and you have no mist or E range to answer yet.
edits.after: Quinn out-ranges you early: Harrier-marked autos and Blinding Assault (Q, 11s) chip you while she kites on passive move speed, and you have no mist or E range to answer.

edits.before: With Q and E you can finally poke and reset, but she can vault your dash and kite away on her speed, so neither of you cleanly wins the trade yet.
edits.after: With Q and E you can poke and reset, but Vault (12s) slows you, interrupts your cone and lands her back at max range — neither of you cleanly wins.

edits.before: You out-scale her hard — a sidelane Quinn loses the duel to your %-HP shred and self-heal, so only her roams and R global threaten you.
edits.after: You out-scale her hard — a sidelane Quinn loses to your %-HP shred and self-heal, so only her roams and the R fast-travel threaten you.

edits.before: Proc Harrier and vault-poke you every time you step up, then kite back on her passive move speed before your E comes off cooldown
edits.after: Proc Harrier and poke you on every step-up, blind you with Blinding Assault (11s), then kite back on passive move speed

edits.before: Quinn's window: Harrier-marked autos and her E vault (knockback + nearsight) out-poke you before you have W mist or enough E range to touch her, so soak minimal damage and just farm.
edits.after: Quinn's window: Harrier-marked autos plus Blinding Assault (Q, 11s) out-poke you before you have mist or the E range to touch her, and Vault (12s) slows you and lands her back at max range. Just farm.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 belong to Quinn and you have to accept it. Her Harrier passive marks you for a heavy nimble auto, and her E vaults over you for a knockback and nearsight, so every time you walk up to Q she pokes and kites away on her passive move speed. You have no W mist and not enough E range to reliably touch her yet, so last-hit at the tip of Snip Snip! and don't chase a vault you can't catch. Her poke is real but it can't kill you if you farm safe and respect her range.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 belong to Quinn. Harrier marks you for a heavy nimble auto, Blinding Assault (Q, 11s) hinders your vision, and Vault slows you, briefly interrupts your cone and drops her back at max attack range — so every walk-up ends with her kiting off on passive move speed. With no mist and not enough E range yet, last-hit at the tip of Snip Snip! and do not chase a Vault you cannot catch. Her poke is real, but it cannot kill you if you farm safe.

edits.before: You own the scaling and the straight 1v1 from your first item on. With Riftmaker/Nashor's and anti-heal, your %-max-HP Snip Snip! plus Thousand Cuts healing delete a Quinn who builds no defensive stats and has no sustain — one E into mist on top of her is a kill. Her only real outs are roaming and split-pushing with her R global, so close the game before she turns the map into her playground; in a sidelane she simply loses the duel to your %-HP shred and self-heal.
edits.after: You own the scaling and the straight 1v1 from your first item on. With Riftmaker/Nashor's and anti-heal, %-max-HP Snip Snip! plus Thousand Cuts healing delete a Quinn who builds no defensive stats — one E into mist on top of her is a kill. Her outs are roaming and split-pushing with Behind Enemy Lines, which is a channelled fast-travel rather than a true global, so it can be caught. Close the game before she turns the map into her playground.

edits.before: Track Quinn's Vault (Dash/Blind): Her self-peel. Snip when it’s down. When it is down — Snip her in your mist.
edits.after: Vault (E, 12s) slows and briefly interrupts you, then lands HER at max range — the blind is Blinding Assault (Q, 11s).

edits.before: - Quinn Vault: matchup-defining — Her self-peel. Snip when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Vault (E): 12/11/10/9/8s — her self-peel; it interrupts your cone but does not displace you. - Blinding Assault (Q): 11s, this is the blind. - Heightened Senses (W): 50s at rank 1 — her speed edge is not permanent.

notes: Behind Enemy Lines shows a cooldown of 3 in the kit file, which is the recast/ending value rather than a real ability cooldown, so I did not print a number for her ultimate anywhere. Blind duration and how it interacts with Skip 'n Slash's on-hit magic damage are not in the kit file and were not asserted.
